title: Baby Sleep Answers
body:
Finally, a good night’s sleep...
Learn the secrets to helping your baby sleep longer and more consistently
YES! I NEED MORE SLEEP!
After months of being woken up every 2-3 hours, I thought motherhood would always be miserable.

I was convinced that I would never get enough sleep, always feel out of control, and just have to deal with it.

My marriage suffered because I was always in a bad mood and snapping at my husband.

I felt completely hopeless.

I read every book on sleep I could find, talked to lots of other parents, and tried all blogs and podcasts I could find ...

But nothing helped.

And then, after just one week … I FELT LIKE MYSELF AGAIN.

The world seemed brighter and happier, and I looked forward to watching my baby grow.

What happened?

I FIGURED OUT BABY SLEEP.

SIGN ME UP!

Exhaustion builds and builds, until you feel like you just have to power through the next years.

If you’re like most exhausted moms, you’ve tried sleep training and it ended up in a lot of tears, no one wants that.

You may have tried googling “Schedule for x month old” and “x month sleep regression” but just got cookie cutter templates and the same simple tips that don’t fit your baby.

You’re probably sick of hearing about all the babies who just did drowsy but awake and sleep all night, all the babies who magically sleep 7-7, but you’re still up at 2 am googling why your baby can’t just sleep. Scrolling through endless posts on Instagram.

Or maybe you’ve given up and decided to just wait until baby grows up and sleeps more.

I’ve worked with parents of 8 and 9-year-olds who said the same thing. And what do they always say when we are done working together?

“I wish I’d worked with you years ago.”

ENROLL NOW
The unfortunate truth? Many moms never figure it out. They suffer through sleepless nights for months on end.
Imagine...

Being able to enjoy bedtime, then being able to spend time with your partner or to go out with your friends again without being worried about coming home in an hour or two.

Going to the kitchen in the morning to enjoy a cup of coffee without worrying about baby waking up at any second.

Being able to set your baby down in their crib happily and walking away knowing you’re going to sleep … all night.

Your friends asking you why your baby is always happy

Having no guilt about how you got your baby to sleep their best sleep.

Being able to tend to them when they need you without being afraid of forming “bad habits,” knowing when they need you versus when they just need a minute.

Imagine having energy to play with your baby, and to figure out what kind of mom you even want to be.

ENROLL NOW

THAT’S WHY I CREATED

The Baby Sleep Course
A proven step-by-step guide to getting your baby the sleep they need.
Tune in to your baby

To figure out their specific sleep needs, and to finally...

GET MORE SLEEP

Help you to see

Why things aren’t working when they aren’t working, and how to fix them so you can...

GET MORE SLEEP

Find a method

That aligns to your parenting, one that doesn’t make you feel guilty, but lets you and your baby...

GET MORE SLEEP

GET ACCESS NOW
Part 1: The Why

We’ll figure out why your baby isn’t sleeping, understanding the ins and outs of baby sleep so you can finally see what is going on.

Videos and PDFs customized to your situation
You will learn the science and background of sleep (you can choose if you want to learn specifics or just an overview)
I’ll also show you the main reason babies cannot go back to sleep on their own, and how you can overcome that.
You will understand why independent sleep can be so valuable to a baby and if you need to aim for it or not.
Part 2: Tools

Then you’ll receive specific tools to take that information and optimize practices to help your baby start getting the sleep that they (and you) need.

I will hand you the tools to create their perfect, unique, and flexible schedule
You will learn the what, where, and why of a perfect sleep environment
You will have the tools to create your own unique sleep goal and achieve it at your own pace.
Part 3: Troubleshooting

Finally, the last part is to troubleshoot, to continue to understand the ups and downs of issues that disrupt baby sleep and how to recover from them.




Baby sleep isn’t perfect, so you’ll have the priceless troubleshooting guide to help you navigate:

Schedule changes and individual needs
Regressions
Night weaning when you’re ready
What to do when baby skips a nap
How and when to drop a nap

Frequently Asked Questions

Will this course continue to be updated? And will I have access to future versions?

Yes! We are continuously improving and updating our course and once you get it: it’s yours forever! In fact, if there is something you don’t see in the course that you would like to, just email us and we’ll add it!

I’m very busy, how long does it take to get through the course?

Totally depends on you! You could finish it in just a couple of hours and come back to it whenever you need, or you can take it slow, watch all the videos at your pace as you need them, and of course, always come back to them.

Can I use FSA or HSA to pay?

YES! Andrea is a Certified Holistic Drugless Practitioner and as one you can pay for all of our courses and consultations with your FSA or HSA! First Contact your FSA administrator and tell them you’d like to have sleep consultation services covered. They may ask you to ask your pediatrician for a letter of medical necessity, this is easy! Then If you use FSA you may have to prepay and then ask us for a receipt to submit to your FSA administrator. If you use HSA, just use your HSA debit card!

We only have one room we share with baby, will this course still help?

Yes! There are so many ways to improve sleep even when you share a room.

How fast can I expect results?

We are firm believers in that every baby and family is different. This course will help you figure out your specific goal and your own timing. We give you the tools to be successful, it’s up to you to set your own pace. We’ve had people who have gone from nursing all night to sleeping through the night in just three days, and some other families who have chosen to take it very slowly and their progress takes a few months.

Will this work for a family who has only ever co-slept (bed shared) and baby has NEVER slept well?

Yep! It works for everyone who wants to work on getting their baby the most sleep possible! When you buy the course you get a survey so the course knows what type of information to offer you. Be sure to select “currently cosleeping/bedsharing” in the survey!

Can I purchase a followup call later if I don’t want one today?

Yep! We have an affordable option called the troubleshooting call, where you can come to us with any issues or questions that arise as you start the course!

My spouse thinks we should be able to do this on our own without a “course” or “help” to know how to parent, how can I get them on board?

It takes a village to raise a child! It takes different skills and people who know different specificities. If your child was not eating, you would never hesitate to find a specialist to make sure he was getting the nutrition he needed. Sleep should be one of your main priorities as a human being too! There is no shame in needing help and learning something new. If they need more help convincing, ask them to read some of our 500+ 5 star reviews online!

We don’t start the night out with our baby in our bed. However, after the first wakeup, our baby sleeps in bed with us for the rest of the night. Is that considered co-sleeping?

While we don’t consider that full on co-sleeping, it can seem quite tricky to figure out how to stop this. The cool thing about our course is that it shows you how to optimize sleep so your baby stops waking up so much and you may not even need to bring them in your bed within a week of figuring out their sleep!

My baby is about 3 months old. Which course should I buy?

This Baby course is perfect for you! I’ve seen a lot of people saying not to “sleep train” until closer to 4-6 months but that usually means don’t do “cry it out” or just “ferber” and that is definitely not what this course will suggest.

My baby is about 2 years old. Which course should I buy?

Fortunately we have a toddler course for 2+ year olds! I recommend it!

Should I buy a Troubleshooting Consultation or a Full Consultation?

It is entirely up to you! Some people like to have just a one time chat to air out their issues and ask questions (Troubleshooting) and some people really like to have a hand to hold as they go through the process (Full consult)

What if I’m not ready to “sleep train” my baby? Will these sleep courses still be helpful?

1000%! This course helps you optimize sleep even before/without ever sleep training. It will also help you teach baby independent sleep but that’s at your pace and when and if it ever becomes your goal!

I am pregnant with my first baby. Should I wait until after my baby is born to purchase the Newborn Sleep Course?

I recommend parents get the newborn sleep course around 36/37 weeks. Newborn parent brain can be quite a haze and hard to really know what you’re doing, but it’s a great time to revisit stuff you learned before baby arrived!

What different sleep training methods are offered in your Baby Sleep Course?

We offer a LOT of different methods. When you buy the course you receive a survey that you fill out and it will ask you what type of methods you’d like to see. Then you’ll be able to see a collection of methods that adhere to that style. AND as a bonus I include help to create your own method so everything you try feels right in your gut!

I’ve done a lot of my own online research into baby sleep. Is there anything included in your courses that cannot be easily found on an internet search?

Yes! I am a mom of 3 and have helped thousands of families personally. I include my experiences and nuances of sleep. But even without that, you can spend hours and weeks of your own time scouring the research and finding your or you can make use of my years of research and experience. BUT if you’ve spent hours doing your own research and are still not sleeping... there is something you’re missing still ;).

I am not comfortable with any crying whatsoever. Will your course still help my baby sleep better?

Yep! I’ve worked with hundreds of “zero crying” parents (Including myself and my sisters) and we always find success. “Success” is relative, of course, and you need more time and patience, but if your parenting style is zero crying on their own, this course will still help you!

faq.question: Will this course continue to be updated? And will I have access to future versions?
faq.full:
Will this course continue to be updated? And will I have access to future versions?

Yes! We are continuously improving and updating our course and once you get it: it’s yours forever! In fact, if there is something you don’t see in the course that you would like to, just email us and we’ll add it!

faq.question: I’m very busy, how long does it take to get through the course?
faq.full:
I’m very busy, how long does it take to get through the course?

Totally depends on you! You could finish it in just a couple of hours and come back to it whenever you need, or you can take it slow, watch all the videos at your pace as you need them, and of course, always come back to them.

faq.question: Can I use FSA or HSA to pay?
faq.full:
Can I use FSA or HSA to pay?

YES! Andrea is a Certified Holistic Drugless Practitioner and as one you can pay for all of our courses and consultations with your FSA or HSA! First Contact your FSA administrator and tell them you’d like to have sleep consultation services covered. They may ask you to ask your pediatrician for a letter of medical necessity, this is easy! Then If you use FSA you may have to prepay and then ask us for a receipt to submit to your FSA administrator. If you use HSA, just use your HSA debit card!

faq.question: We only have one room we share with baby, will this course still help?
faq.full:
We only have one room we share with baby, will this course still help?

Yes! There are so many ways to improve sleep even when you share a room.

faq.question: How fast can I expect results?
faq.full:
How fast can I expect results?

We are firm believers in that every baby and family is different. This course will help you figure out your specific goal and your own timing. We give you the tools to be successful, it’s up to you to set your own pace. We’ve had people who have gone from nursing all night to sleeping through the night in just three days, and some other families who have chosen to take it very slowly and their progress takes a few months.

faq.question: Will this work for a family who has only ever co-slept (bed shared) and baby has NEVER slept well?
faq.full:
Will this work for a family who has only ever co-slept (bed shared) and baby has NEVER slept well?

Yep! It works for everyone who wants to work on getting their baby the most sleep possible! When you buy the course you get a survey so the course knows what type of information to offer you. Be sure to select “currently cosleeping/bedsharing” in the survey!

faq.question: Can I purchase a followup call later if I don’t want one today?
faq.full:
Can I purchase a followup call later if I don’t want one today?

Yep! We have an affordable option called the troubleshooting call, where you can come to us with any issues or questions that arise as you start the course!

faq.question: My spouse thinks we should be able to do this on our own without a “course” or “help” to know how to parent, how can I get them on board?
faq.full:
My spouse thinks we should be able to do this on our own without a “course” or “help” to know how to parent, how can I get them on board?

It takes a village to raise a child! It takes different skills and people who know different specificities. If your child was not eating, you would never hesitate to find a specialist to make sure he was getting the nutrition he needed. Sleep should be one of your main priorities as a human being too! There is no shame in needing help and learning something new. If they need more help convincing, ask them to read some of our 500+ 5 star reviews online!

faq.question: We don’t start the night out with our baby in our bed. However, after the first wakeup, our baby sleeps in bed with us for the rest of the night. Is that considered co-sleeping?
faq.full:
We don’t start the night out with our baby in our bed. However, after the first wakeup, our baby sleeps in bed with us for the rest of the night. Is that considered co-sleeping?

While we don’t consider that full on co-sleeping, it can seem quite tricky to figure out how to stop this. The cool thing about our course is that it shows you how to optimize sleep so your baby stops waking up so much and you may not even need to bring them in your bed within a week of figuring out their sleep!

faq.question: My baby is about 3 months old. Which course should I buy?
faq.full:
My baby is about 3 months old. Which course should I buy?

This Baby course is perfect for you! I’ve seen a lot of people saying not to “sleep train” until closer to 4-6 months but that usually means don’t do “cry it out” or just “ferber” and that is definitely not what this course will suggest.

faq.question: My baby is about 2 years old. Which course should I buy?
faq.full:
My baby is about 2 years old. Which course should I buy?

Fortunately we have a toddler course for 2+ year olds! I recommend it!

faq.question: Should I buy a Troubleshooting Consultation or a Full Consultation?
faq.full:
Should I buy a Troubleshooting Consultation or a Full Consultation?

It is entirely up to you! Some people like to have just a one time chat to air out their issues and ask questions (Troubleshooting) and some people really like to have a hand to hold as they go through the process (Full consult)

faq.question: What if I’m not ready to “sleep train” my baby? Will these sleep courses still be helpful?
faq.full:
What if I’m not ready to “sleep train” my baby? Will these sleep courses still be helpful?

1000%! This course helps you optimize sleep even before/without ever sleep training. It will also help you teach baby independent sleep but that’s at your pace and when and if it ever becomes your goal!

faq.question: I am pregnant with my first baby. Should I wait until after my baby is born to purchase the Newborn Sleep Course?
faq.full:
I am pregnant with my first baby. Should I wait until after my baby is born to purchase the Newborn Sleep Course?

I recommend parents get the newborn sleep course around 36/37 weeks. Newborn parent brain can be quite a haze and hard to really know what you’re doing, but it’s a great time to revisit stuff you learned before baby arrived!

faq.question: What different sleep training methods are offered in your Baby Sleep Course?
faq.full:
What different sleep training methods are offered in your Baby Sleep Course?

We offer a LOT of different methods. When you buy the course you receive a survey that you fill out and it will ask you what type of methods you’d like to see. Then you’ll be able to see a collection of methods that adhere to that style. AND as a bonus I include help to create your own method so everything you try feels right in your gut!

faq.question: I’ve done a lot of my own online research into baby sleep. Is there anything included in your courses that cannot be easily found on an internet search?
faq.full:
I’ve done a lot of my own online research into baby sleep. Is there anything included in your courses that cannot be easily found on an internet search?

Yes! I am a mom of 3 and have helped thousands of families personally. I include my experiences and nuances of sleep. But even without that, you can spend hours and weeks of your own time scouring the research and finding your or you can make use of my years of research and experience. BUT if you’ve spent hours doing your own research and are still not sleeping... there is something you’re missing still ;).

faq.question: I am not comfortable with any crying whatsoever. Will your course still help my baby sleep better?
faq.full:
I am not comfortable with any crying whatsoever. Will your course still help my baby sleep better?

Yep! I’ve worked with hundreds of “zero crying” parents (Including myself and my sisters) and we always find success. “Success” is relative, of course, and you need more time and patience, but if your parenting style is zero crying on their own, this course will still help you!
